full_details.title: be-you website
full_details.full_description:
I’m building an online ecosystem whose single purpose is to connect travelers with the right local partners. The platform has to feel effortless for a visitor: they land on the site, browse or search partner profiles, and can immediately start a conversation or request further details.

Scope of work
• Architect a responsive web application from database up through polished front-end.  
• Implement secure user registration for both traveler and partner accounts, including profile creation, photo uploads, location tagging, and basic messaging.  
• Design a clear partner-discovery flow (search, filters, profile cards, “connect” button).  
• Provide an admin dashboard so I can approve, edit, or deactivate any listing.  
• Deploy the finished site to my hosting environment and supply concise setup/maintenance documentation.

Acceptance criteria
• A traveler can register, complete a profile, find at least one partner, and exchange a message without admin assistance.  
• Page load times stay under three seconds on a standard 4G mobile connection.  
• Codebase is clean, version-controlled, and delivered with a read-me that lets another developer stand the site back up in under one hour.

If you have a track record building community or marketplace platforms and can suggest the right tech stack for fast searches and secure data handling, let’s talk timelines and milestones—my goal is to launch a reliable MVP quickly and iterate from there.
